journey.name: Mobility
journey.description: Train's Mobility pillar lists the flows by when each is for. A flow opens on a sheet of what is in it, and Start runs it on the workout screen: each move named with how it is done, counted down, a side at a time, with a few seconds to change sides and to get into the next. A move that is one of Lift's exercises (the mat flow's) is shown by Lift's figure: on its page from the sheet, and over the ring as it runs. A finished flow is kept as mobility: it counts toward the week, and Log names it. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval), with the voice on and the sound up.

actions.action: On "Set up", which a fresh install opens on, tap "Skip for now"
Tap the "Train" tab, then "Mobility" in the picker under the title

Verify that "Before training" lists "Hips and shoulders" (6 moves · no bell, 8:00), "Wrists and fingers" (5 moves · before the wall, 5:00), "Core for falls" (5 moves · no bell, 7:00) and "Before rolling" (6 moves · before BJJ, 9:00), and "After, or on a day off" lists four more with their lengths, "After rolling" (6 moves · after BJJ, 12:00) among them
Tap "Wrists and fingers"

Verify that its sheet says "Mobility · 5 moves · before the wall" and "5:00", has "Start" above the moves, and lists "Wrist circles" 0:30 down to "Forearm stretch" 0:30 a side, each with a line on how it is done
Tap "Start"
Verify that the workout shows "Get ready" with "Wrist circles" and its line over the clock and "Move 1 of 5" in the status, and that the voice says "Next: Wrist circles"
Wait for the countdown to end and verify that the ring says "Move", the voice says "Begin", and the line under the clock says "Next: Palms down, fingers back"
Tap "Skip" until "Finger pulls" is shown with "Left side" under it; wait out the side and verify "Switch sides" for five seconds, the voice saying so, then "Right side"
Tap "+10s" and verify that the clock gains ten seconds; tap "Back" and verify that the side starts again from its full time

Turn the screen off for twenty seconds, turn it on, and verify that the notification names the move ("Finger pulls · Right side · Move 4 of 5" or the one it has reached) and that the workout is as far on as the time gone
Tap "Skip" until the summary shows
Verify that it says "Done", "5 moves" with the total, "Wrists and fingers · Mobility · 5 moves" and "Saved to your log", with "Moves" 5/5 and no "Save as preset"; tap "Done"
Verify that Train is shown again on "Mobility"
Tap the "Train" tab's "Conditioning" pillar, then "Timer", and verify that the Timer's settings are as they were (0:30 work, 0:15 rest, 8 rounds); go back
Tap the "Today" tab and verify that the week says "1 workout" and "1 mobility", with today marked done
Tap the "Log" tab and verify that "Done this week" lists "Wrists and fingers" with "Mobility · 5 moves" on the "Today" row
Tap it, then "Repeat now", and verify that the workout shows "Get ready" with "Wrist circles"; tap "End", then "End workout"
Tap the "Train" tab, "Mobility", then "Core on the mat", and verify that each move's row ends in a small still of a figure; tap "The hundred"

Verify that the sheet now shows the move's page: "Move 1 of 9 · 1:40 · Moved through", its line on how it is done, a figure doing the hundred with "Pause" over it, a timeline under it and three cues lit in turn as the figure does them; tap the last cue and verify the figure jumps to it; tap "Back to the moves" and verify "Start" is back

Tap "Start" and verify that "Get ready" shows the hundred's figure moving in a band between its name and the ring, the ring smaller than on "Wrists and fingers"; tap the ring to pause and verify the figure holds still; tap again and verify it moves on
Tap the figure and verify its page opens over the running workout with the figure, its cues and "Back to the moves"; tap it and verify the clock has run on meanwhile; tap "End", then "End workout"

Tap "Core for falls" and verify that each row ends in a figure; tap "Spinal rock" and verify its page shows a figure sitting up, rocking back onto the shoulders with the head off the mat and up again, then tap "Back to the moves"
